title: Broadband routes 30 publication-handoff cases without automatic publication
summary: 3 complete accept fixtures reach a separate publication-review queue, 15 non-accept fixtures terminate without handoff, and 12 invalid accept fixtures are rejected. Denominator: 30 state-machine cases across 3 contracts; zero actual handoffs, triggers, closures, or publications.
